name: Annemarie Börlind
desc: Black Forest natural-cosmetics maker developing and manufacturing face-care ranges in-house at Calw and selling through regional sites in Europe, North America and Asia.
products: Face care: moisturisers, night creams, cleansers, serums, masks; NATUNEO, ROSENTAU, ZZ SENSITIVE ranges
customers: Consumers via pharmacies, retailers and online
markets: Germany, Austria, France, Netherlands, Portugal, Greece, Czech Republic, Slovakia, US, Canada, China, Vietnam (country sites)
fit_rationale: Small natural-cosmetics house with a premium eco positioning; F1's fuel-powered image clashes with its brand values and no scale figure supports a sponsorship budget.
outstanding: Revenue, employees and ownership not on site; no qualifying route shown.

name: Lystek
desc: Canadian biosolids and organics processor using Lystek THP technology at fourteen installations, owned by the Tomlinson Group since 2011.
products: Lystek THP biosolids technology, fertiliser products, organic material recovery centres
stores_or_sites: 14 installations incl. Southgate OMRC (Ontario) and Fairfield OMRC (California)
markets: Canada, United States and United Arab Emirates
fit_rationale: Niche municipal biosolids processor selling to utilities; no consumer brand and no scale data, so an F1 programme has little commercial logic.

name: Grupo León Jimenes
desc: León family-controlled Dominican investment group holding a 15% stake in brewer Cervecería Nacional Dominicana after selling its cigar and cigarette businesses.
products: Minority stake in Cervecería Nacional Dominicana (Presidente beer); private-equity style investments; Centro León
fit_rationale: Now mainly a minority investor; its beer interest is controlled by AB InBev/AmBev, so there is no operating brand of its own to put on a car.
category_conflict: potential: beer stake controlled by AB InBev group
outstanding: No revenue or scale data; current portfolio.
